title: server: protocol-06 §5.8 identifierQuery endpoint (inbound + outbound)
description: mimid neither serves nor calls §5.8 identifierQuery; wire types exist (crates/mimi-protocol/src/identifier.rs, decisions .5.19, .5.35, .5.71, .5.73; pending localfix .5.74). Not scoped by any decision. Scope to decide: which query element types mimid answers (Haven answers only a single Handle and returns no body oracle, its DIV-4), privacy posture (no existence oracle), outbound client in PeerClient, directory entry (see mimid-1wgh.6.78). Needs a decision bead on what mimid answers before code. Haven serves it, so the live harness can test it.
design:
PLAN (2026-11-02, awaiting Mark; implement only after mimid-1wgh.7.32 lands, since both edit http.rs, directory.rs and peer.rs). protocol-06 §5.8 L2337-2563.

Fact: mimid has no profile data (no names/nicks/email/phone), no per-user search policy, and no JMAP surface to set one; a local user's only identifier is its mimi:// URI.

Inbound: route POST /v1/identifierQuery/{domain}; directory lists identifierQuery again; strict IdentifierRequest decode (existing type, decisions .5.73); answer 200 with an IdentifierResponse body for every decodable request (§5.8 carries the outcome in responseCode, not HTTP status); 400 for undecodable body or bad From; path domain must be this provider (400 otherwise, as .7.37).
Policy (decision needed, options):
 (A) always responseCode forbidden ('use of this endpoint is not allowed by the provider'), empty results. No existence oracle, no data needed. Zach-by-default for everyone.
 (B) answer only an exact 'handle' query whose value is a local user's mimi:// URI: success with that URI (only if the user has a client, as .7.36) else notFound; unsupportedField for any other search type; forbidden for multi-element requests. Gives an existence oracle for anyone who already knows the URI.
 (C) like B but only for users listed in a server config opt-in list (Yolanda model), everyone else notFound.
Outbound: PeerClient::identifier_query(domain, body) -> response bytes (post_read, 200), variable {domain}; NotOffered if absent.
Tests: inbound with the committed Haven fixture crates/mimi-protocol/tests/fixtures/haven/identifier_request.bin (independent encoder) -> expected IdentifierResponse bytes hand-encoded per §5.8; bad From / wrong path domain -> 400; outbound against a local axum server (path, From, exact body; non-200 -> Rejected; absent -> NotOffered). Follow published -06 IdentifierResponse (pending localfix .5.74 unchanged).
Decision beads: the policy choice; 200-for-every-outcome.
notes:
2026-11-02 Mark: option B (exact handle), outbound client included. Decisions: mimid-1wgh.7.38, mimid-1wgh.7.39, mimid-1wgh.7.40; wg mimid-1wgh.37.93. Implement after mimid-1wgh.7.32 lands (shared files).
2026-11-02 implemented (uncommitted, worktree agent-a9faa004cc874f03f on 97ea379): route POST /v1/identifierQuery/{domain} -> follower/identifier.rs (decisions .7.38/.7.39/.7.40); FollowerError::PathNotThisProvider -> 400; directory lists identifierQuery; PeerClient::identifier_query (post_read, 200). Tests: tests/identifier_query.rs (4; all failed before impl; hand-encoded requests/responses + Haven identifier_request.bin, which is handle AND vcardField so it yields unsupportedField, not a pure handle query), tests/peer_identifier.rs (3; failed to compile before). Existing tests changed: directory.rs unit test (adds identifierQuery, per .5.75 now that it is routed). Six gates pass (92 suites). Search values are not logged; work per request is one decode (body-capped) and at most one store query.
close_reason: protocol-06 §5.8 inbound POST /v1/identifierQuery/{domain} per decisions .7.38/.7.39/.7.40 (exact-handle success for local users with a client; notFound; unsupportedField for non-handle; forbidden for empty; 200 always, 400 for bad body/From/path) + PeerClient::identifier_query. Tests identifier_query.rs (hand-encoded requests/responses, Haven fixture -> unsupportedField), peer_identifier.rs; all failed first. Six gates pass on main (92 suites).
